print(f"P gain: {zcontrol.PGain}, I gain: {zcontrol.IGain}, D gain: {zcontrol.DGain}")
print(f"Time per line: {scan.Scantime} s, Lines per frame: {scan.Lines}")

del spm
"}

import time

# Load application
spm = nanosurf.SPM()
application = spm.application
scan = application.Scan

print("Starting Scan 1...")
# Start scan
scan.StartFrameUp()

# Wait for scan to complete
scanning = scan.IsScanning
while scanning:
    remaining = scan.Lines - scan.Currentline
    print(f"Scanning in progress... Remaining lines: {remaining}")
    time.sleep(1)
    scanning = scan.IsScanning

print("Scan 1 finished!")
del spm
"}
